fx_framing: A sprite sheet of ONE short visual-effect animation for a 2D top-down pixel-art survival game: a grid of {cols} columns and {rows} rows of equally sized square cells holding {n} frames in reading order (left to right, then the next row). Fully transparent background. Each frame sits in the middle of its own cell with a wide empty margin; nothing touches or crosses the cell borders; the effect has the same scale and the same anchor point in every frame, and consecutive frames change smoothly so they play as a fluid animation. Bold, simple, readable shapes with clear stepped cel shading (3 to 5 tones) and crisp edges, so it still reads when shrunk to a tiny pixel sprite. No text, no numbers, no labels, no grid lines, no cell borders, no background colour, no ground, no cast shadow.
fx_style: Classic 16-bit pixel-art game effect look (like Enter the Gungeon, Hyper Light Drifter, Project Zomboid effects); gritty Soviet post-apocalyptic mood, colours slightly desaturated except light-emitting parts (fire, sparks, flashes, flares) which stay bright and saturated.

assets.desc: a single puff of light grey smoke: frame 1 a small dense round puff, it swells into a soft lumpy cloud and slowly thins out and breaks apart into wisps by the last frame; light grey with white highlights on the top-left and blue-grey shadow on the bottom-right

a thick oily black smoke billow from a burning wreck: a heavy rolling cumulus of near-black and dark brown-grey smoke that churns and expands, with a faint dull orange underglow at the bottom of the first frames; by the last frames it is wider and slightly thinner

a puff of dense bright crimson-red signal smoke from a smoke flare: a round red puff that swells into a soft lumpy cloud and slowly thins out into pink-red wisps; saturated red with light pink highlights and dark red shadows

a puff of dense acid-green signal smoke from a smoke grenade: a round green puff that swells into a soft lumpy cloud and slowly thins into pale green wisps; saturated green with pale highlights and dark green shadows
a puff of dense mustard-yellow signal smoke: a round yellow puff that swells into a soft lumpy cloud and slowly thins into pale yellow wisps; yellow with cream highlights and ochre shadows

a big dense white-grey smoke-grenade cloud spreading low over the ground: starts as a tight burst and billows outward into a wide lumpy flattened cloud of many round puffs, then slowly thins; off-white with grey shadows

a burst of dry tan-brown dust kicked up from the ground by an impact or a landing: a low wide puff spreading sideways along the ground and rising a little, then settling and fading; sandy beige with brown shadows
same as dust_puff

a thin curling wisp of grey chimney smoke rising straight up from a small source at the bottom center and drifting slightly to the right, looping animation where the curls move upward; tall and narrow, pale grey

a small campfire or torch flame looping flicker: a few orange and yellow tongues of fire with a white-yellow core and a dark red rim, licking upward, base at the bottom center; each frame a slightly different flame shape so it loops
same as fire_small

a medium patch of burning fuel fire looping flicker (molotov fire on the ground): several tall orange and yellow tongues of flame with a bright yellow-white core and dark red tips, wide base at the bottom; each frame different so it loops

a big roaring fire from a burning wrecked vehicle, looping flicker: a tall wide mass of orange, yellow and red flames with a white-hot core, dark red and black smoky tips at the top; each frame different so it loops
a few glowing orange and yellow ember sparks rising up from a fire and drifting, small bright dots and short streaks that move upward and fade out; looping

a small explosion of a hand grenade or satchel charge seen from above at a 3/4 angle: frame 1 a white-yellow flash, then a round fireball of orange and yellow with red edges, then it turns into dark grey smoke with a few flying debris specks, last frames dissipating smoke

a big powerful explosion of a C4 charge or rocket seen from above at a 3/4 angle: frame 1 a blinding white flash, then a huge expanding orange-yellow fireball with a red rim, chunks of concrete debris and dirt flying outward, then a rolling column of black and grey smoke with dying flames inside, last frames thin dark smoke
an expanding shockwave ring of dust on the ground seen from directly above: a thin pale bright ring that grows outward and gets thinner and more transparent with each frame, empty in the middle

a pistol muzzle flash seen from the side, the gun muzzle is at the left edge and the flash shoots to the right: a small bright yellow-white star-shaped burst with a few orange spikes; each frame a different burst shape

an assault rifle (AK) muzzle flash seen from the side, the muzzle is at the left edge and the flash shoots to the right: a long bright yellow-white cone with a forked star of orange spikes and a hot white core; each frame a different shape

a shotgun muzzle blast seen from the side, the muzzle is at the left edge and the blast shoots to the right: a big wide fan of orange and yellow fire with a white core and a puff of grey smoke at its end; frames go from the biggest blast to fading smoke
a tiny suppressed muzzle flash seen from the side, the muzzle is at the left edge: a very small dim pale-yellow puff with a little grey smoke; each frame slightly different and smaller
a burst of bright yellow-white metal sparks from a bullet ricochet on steel: short straight streaks flying out in a fan from the center, then fewer and dimmer orange sparks
a burst of small brown wood chips and splinters with a little pale sawdust flying out from a bullet hit on a wooden plank, then falling and fading
a burst of small grey stone chips and pale concrete dust flying out from a bullet hit on a wall, then a small dust cloud that fades
a small stylized burst of dark red droplets from a hit, cartoony and not gory: a few round dark-red drops and a tiny splash flying out and falling, then fading
a water splash on a pond surface: a crown of white and light-blue water droplets jumping up from the bottom center with ripples, then the droplets fall back and a ring of ripples remains and fades
a burst of small sharp pale-cyan glass shards glinting with white highlights, flying outward from the center and falling

a burning red signal flare hanging in the air: a blinding white-pink core surrounded by intense crimson-red fire and a ring of red glow, a few red sparks dripping down; looping flicker, each frame slightly different
an electric short-circuit spark burst: jagged bright blue-white lightning arcs and small white-yellow sparks crackling out from the center, then fading to a few dim blue sparks
a jet of white steam hissing out of a leaking pipe at the bottom-left and puffing up and to the right, swelling into a soft white cloud that thins and fades
